lines.beaver: 너 그 소문 들었어? 숲에 큰 짐승이 산대.
lines.beaver_en: Did you hear the rumor? A big beast lives in the forest.
lines.beaver_roman: neo geu somun deureosseo? supe keun jimseungi sandae.
lines.learner: 큰 짐승? 우리 동네 숲에 그런 게 있을 리가 없어.
lines.en: A big beast? There's no way that's in our forest.
lines.roman: keun jimseung? uri dongne supe geureon ge isseul liga eopseo.

lines.beaver_en: It's true. Even a hunter saw it at midnight.
lines.learner: 거기는 사냥 금지야. 사냥꾼이 있을 리가 없지.
lines.en: Hunting is banned there. No way a hunter was there.
lines.roman: geogineun sanyang geumjiya. sanyangkkuni isseul liga eopji.

lines.beaver_en: They say the beast eats turtles.
lines.learner: 거북이 등은 딱딱해. 쉽게 먹을 리가 없어.
lines.en: A turtle's shell is hard. No way it eats them easily.
lines.roman: geobugi deungeun ttakttakae. swipge meogeul liga eopseo.

lines.beaver_en: And it goes meow, like a cat.
lines.learner: 큰 짐승이 야옹 하고 울 리가 없잖아.
lines.en: There's no way a big beast says meow.
lines.roman: keun jimseungi yaong hago ul liga eopjana.

lines.beaver: 또 거미가 사람만큼 크대. 거미줄도 봤대.
lines.beaver_en: Also, a spider is as big as a person. They saw its web.
lines.beaver_roman: tto geomiga sarammankeum keudae. geomijuldo bwatdae.
lines.learner: 사람만큼 큰 거미? 그런 거미가 있을 리 없어.
lines.en: A spider as big as a person? No way that exists.
lines.roman: sarammankeum keun geomi? geureon geomiga isseul li eopseo.

lines.beaver_en: And frogs and turtles suddenly decreased a lot.
lines.en: Really? There still seemed to be quite a lot of frogs.

lines.beaver: 그 짐승이 씨앗도 먹는대. 그래서 꽃이 없대.
lines.beaver_en: It eats seeds too. That's why there are no flowers.
lines.beaver_roman: geu jimseungi ssiatdo meongneundae. geuraeseo kkochi eopdae.
lines.learner: 고기 먹는 짐승이 씨앗을 먹을 리가 없지.
lines.en: No way a meat-eating beast eats seeds.
lines.roman: gogi meongneun jimseungi ssiaseul meogeul liga eopji.

lines.beaver: 듣고 보니 좀 이상하네. 내가 너무 믿었나?
lines.beaver_en: Now that I hear it, it's strange. Did I believe it too easily?
lines.beaver_roman: deutgo boni jom isanghane. naega neomu mideonna?
lines.en: Yeah. Rumors get a little bigger every time.

lines.beaver: 맞아. 그럼 주말에 같이 숲에 가 볼래?
lines.beaver_en: Right. Then want to go to the forest together this weekend?
lines.beaver_roman: maja. geureom jumare gachi supe ga bollae?
lines.en: Sure. Let's look for frogs and spiders ourselves.

lines.beaver_en: Great! Let's go and see for ourselves if it's true.
lines.learner: 그래. 큰 짐승은 절대 없을 거야. 하하.
lines.en: Okay. There's definitely no big beast. Haha.
lines.roman: geurae. keun jimseungeun jeoldae eopseul geoya. haha.
